entries.notes: Approved for Phase 1 commercial voiceover generation. Subscription tier: Azure Pay-as-you-go / Standard (Standard tier governed by Microsoft's Online Services Terms / Product Terms; commercial use permitted). Voice family: Azure Standard Neural voices (e.g., en-US-JennyNeural, en-US-GuyNeural); these are made available for commercial use under the Cognitive Services Speech Service Specific Terms without requiring Microsoft's separate Personal Voice consent or a Custom Neural Voice Limited Use agreement. Determination authority: operator self-determination per the published Azure terms cited above; no outside counsel engaged. Volume: bounded by the deployment's Pay-as-you-go metering; no separate volume commitment required for Phase 1. Data handling: per Cognitive Services Speech Service Specific Terms, no customer data is retained beyond the synthesis call by default; the deployment uses default (non-Custom-Neural-Voice) handling. Provider invocations are gated by EnforceLicenseRouting via the AssemblySpec.voiceover.source.providerId lookup in apps/application/src/use-cases/assemble-delivery-reel.ts.
